series_start_reason: The Q1 2015 release (6-K 2015-05-06) prints no Arnuity row; the first printed sales are Q2 2015 (6-K 2015-07-29). 2015 full year (3) = Q2 1 + Q3 1 + Q4 1 confirms no Q1 sales.
series_end_reason: From the Q1 2024 release (6-K 2024-05-01) the respiratory table has no Arnuity Ellipta row (folded into Other Respiratory). The Q4 2023 release (6-K 2024-01-31) is the last that prints it.
notes: Worldwide GSK turnover for Arnuity Ellipta in GBP millions. The row label is 'Arnuity' in the 2015Q2 and 2015Q3 releases and 'Arnuity Ellipta' from the Q4 2015 release. 2015Q2-2015Q4 come from the 'Sales from New Pharmaceutical and Vaccine products' table; from 2016Q1 the product is in the regional 'Pharmaceuticals turnover' table (Total column used). Most sales are U.S. (regional split printed in each quote). FDA approval 2014-08-20; no cited document dates a launch quarter, so launch_quarter is null.
